question: Who among the following is a Padma Vibhushan awardee and a torch bearer of the Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Lucknow?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Birju Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** was a renowned Indian Kathak dancer and a torch bearer of the Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Lucknow.
 
• He received the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan** award in 1986.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was known for his extraordinary contributions to the classical dance form of Kathak.
 
• He was born into a family of Kathak dancers and was the son of the illustrious Achhan Maharaj.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was also a proficient singer, poet, and musician.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• It originated from the northern Indian states and is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• The word 'Kathak' is derived from 'Katha', which means a story.
 
• Kathak dancers traditionally perform to the accompaniment of classical Hindustani music.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field, including government service.
 
• The award was instituted in 1954 and is conferred by the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Kalka-Bindadin Gharana**
 
 
• The Kalka-Bindadin Gharana, also known as the Lucknow Gharana, is one of the three main gharanas of Kathak dance.
 
• It emphasizes grace, elegance, and the expressive aspect of Kathak.
 
• The gharana was founded by brothers Kalka Prasad and Bindadin Maharaj in the 19th century.
 
 
 
• **Birju Maharaj's Contributions**
 
 
• Birju Maharaj choreographed many dance dramas and ballets, blending traditional and contemporary themes.
 
• He also contributed to the popularization of Kathak on international platforms, bringing Indian classical dance to global audiences.
 
• He established the Kalashram, a dance school in Delhi, to train future generations of Kathak dancers.
